title: Lug storage cleanup - rescue backup and temp artifacts
description: When lug storage is reworked (e.g., migration to sharded structure), the system must scan for and rescue trapped information from backup/temp/sidecar lug artifacts before cleanup. This preserves review trails, implementation history, and other valuable data that may exist outside the primary WAI-Lugs.jsonl file.
rescue_requirements: Scan all WAI-Spoke directories for lug-related backup files
Extract and validate any trapped review notes, implementation feedback, ownership records
Merge valuable data back into canonical lug storage
Verify no review trails or implementation history lost
Document rescue process for future migrations
